title: git_diff
description: Show the unified diff for a git repository (working tree, staged changes, or between two refs).

path.description: Git repository root directory (must be within the allowed path whitelist).

ref1.description: Optional starting ref (e.g. 'HEAD~1', a branch name, or a commit hash).

ref2.description: Optional ending ref, used together with ref1.

file.description: Optional: limit the diff to a single file, relative to path.

staged.description: Whether to show staged changes (git diff --cached).
